claims.content: To capture and register a VSP staff member's details in the VSP Staff Master.

goal.raw_text: To capture and register a VSP staff member's details in the VSP Staff Master.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The MSIU Field Office User is entering a claim into the system.
The VSP Code for the VSP under which the new staff is being created is available.
The information other than Qualification that is mandatory during the creation of new staff under any VSP is available.
The Staff Type Master is available for selecting the Staff Type or entering a new Staff Type.
The MSIU Field Office User needs to register a new VSP staff member while entering a claim into the system.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User needs to register a new VSP staff member while entering a claim into the system.

claims.content: Create new staff under the VSP, with all above information other than Qualification mandatory during creation.
The system automatically creates Staff Code with Suffix as VSP Code + SC + 3 digit, for example HP0001SC0001.
Staff type is selected from the list of staff type listing from Staff Type Master.

2a. If any of the staff type is not available in the system, the system should have the provision to navigate quickly to staff type master to enter the new staff type and then back to Staff Master screen.

If any of the information other than Qualification that is mandatory during the creation of new staff under any VSP is missing, the registration cannot be completed until the missing mandatory information is provided; exit by entering the missing mandatory information and resuming creation.

If any Staff Type is not available in the system, navigate quickly to the Staff Type Master to enter the new Staff Type and then back to the Staff Master screen; exit by returning to the Staff Master screen.
All information other than Qualification that is mandatory during the creation of a new staff member under the VSP has been captured.
A Staff Code has been automatically created with the suffix as VSP Code + SC + 3 digit.
The Staff Type has been selected from the list of staff types listed from the Staff Type Master.
The VSP staff details, including VSP Name, Staff Code, Staff Name, and Staff Type, have been captured in the VSP Staff Master Information.
